proposals.evidence: DEDR 4707 gives Tamil/Malayalam mayir, Irula megaru/meguru/moyiru and Kota/Toda mīr ‘hair’. Only the bare hair noun is selected; tala-mayir ‘head-hair’ responses require an ordered component analysis. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
